title: 第13章 恶魔珩，浴袍珩，狼耳珩-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    终于，完工。

    斯蒂芬接手，喷了一层薄薄的定妆喷雾。

    “老板，多亏了有小汐在！”斯蒂芬现在对韩小汐简直佩服得五体投地。

    “嗯。”沈珩待干透了之后，拉好衣襟，“大炜把报酬付一下。”

    在帮着斯蒂芬收拾工具的韩小汐愣了一下，这回她可没谈要钱。

    郭炜却已经将一个信封递到了她面前。

    “韩小姐，这是给您的。”

    “不用了。”韩小汐连假笑都不愿意。

    “您别误会，这是跟之前的团队谈好的报酬，他们没能完成，而您做到了，这是您应得的。”

    郭炜的解释官方且客气。

    韩小汐偷瞄了沈珩一眼，他已经坐下由斯蒂芬给他弄妆发。

    郭炜手里的信封还举着。

    “谢了。”她在矫情什么，工作而已，拿钱办事，很正常。

    韩小汐笑眯着眼拿钱走人。

    一秒都没有多待，连招呼都没和沈珩打一声。

    ……

    韩小汐刚回到自己的工作区，就被一个道具组的老师拖着去帮忙布置背景了。

    根本无暇回味先前化妆间里似有似无的暧昧。

    另一边，导演助理过来请沈珩，说快轮到他的戏了。

    沈珩点头，随手拿了桌上的外套。

    啪——

    一本本子被衣服顺带掉在了地上。

    沈珩弯腰捡起来，打开。

    扉页：搞钱是第一要务！韩小汐。

    下面还画着一个Q版的小女孩头像。

    笑眯着桃花眼，和她神似。

    沈珩不自觉地扬了嘴角。

    沈珩没想继续窥探小姑娘的秘密，准备先帮她收着，有空再还给她。

    总不能就这般丢在人来人往的化妆间。

    然而就在他把手账本往自己的随身包里放的时候，无意中弄褶了一页。

    他翻开，准备捋平。

    额——

    这画的……是他？！

    竖瞳白肤，吸血鬼的牙齿，蝙蝠的翅膀。

    还有一颗突兀的媒婆痣。

    生怕别人认不出来一般，还在一旁写着三个大字：恶魔珩。

    沈珩哭笑不得。

    他怎么就成恶魔了？

    “老板，导演催了！”郭炜在身后提醒。

    沈珩连忙将手账本合上，塞进包里。

    “别乱翻，帮我收好。”他收起脸上的情绪，将包递给郭炜。

    这才套上外套往片场走。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Finally, it’s finished.

Stephen took over and sprayed on a light layer of setting spray.

"Boss, thank you for having Xiao tide here!" Stephen admired Han Xiaoxi so much now.

"Yes." After Shen Heng was completely dry, he pulled up his clothes and said, "Da Wei, please pay me the reward."

Han Xiaoxi, who was helping Stephen pack the tools, was stunned for a moment. This time she didn’t ask for money.

Guo Wei had already handed an envelope to her.

"Ms. Han, this is for you."

"No need." Han Xiaoxi didn't even want to fake a smile.

"Don't get me wrong, this is the reward negotiated with the previous team. They failed to complete it, but you did it. This is what you deserve."

Guo Wei’s explanation was official and polite.

Han Xiaoxi glanced at Shen Heng, who had already sat down and let Stephen do his makeup and hair.

Guo Wei is still holding the envelope in his hand.

"Thanks." What is she being pretentious about? It's just a job, and it's normal to get paid to do things.

Han Xiaoxi smiled, took the money and left.

He didn’t wait for a second, and didn’t even say hello to Shen Heng.

……

As soon as Han Xiaoxi returned to her workspace, she was dragged by a teacher from the props team to help decorate the background.

There was no time to recall the ambiguity that seemed to exist in the dressing room before.

On the other side, the director’s assistant came over to invite Shen Heng, saying that it was almost his turn to play.

Shen Heng nodded and took the coat on the table.

∣

A book was dropped to the ground by the clothes.

Shen Heng bent down to pick it up and opened it.

Title page: Making money is the first priority!Han Xiaoxi.

There is also a Q version of a little girl’s head drawn below.

Smiling with peach blossom eyes, he looks like her.

Shen Heng raised the corners of his mouth unconsciously.

Shen Heng didn’t want to continue to pry into the little girl’s secrets, so he planned to keep it for her and return it to her when he had time.

You can’t just leave it in the dressing room where people come and go.

However, when he put his account book into his bag, he accidentally wrinkled a page.

He opened it and prepared to flatten it.

Um——

This painting... is him?!

Vertical pupils, white skin, vampire teeth, bat wings.

There is also an unexpected matchmaker mole.

For fear that others would not recognize it, three big characters were written on the side: Devil Heng.

Shen Heng couldn’t laugh or cry.

How did he become a devil?

“Boss, the director is urging me!” Guo Wei reminded from behind.

Shen Heng quickly closed the ledger and stuffed it into his bag.

"Don't rummage around and put it away for me." He put away the emotion on his face and handed the bag to Guo Wei.

Then I put on my coat and walked to the set.
